description: An NHS-approved tablet-delivered falls-prevention programme co-developed with older adults and falls-prevention experts, combining progressive strength-and-balance exercises with eCoach guidance, safety information, reminders, progress tracking, and health-literacy games for older adults.
title: KOKU

description: Kolibri is Learning Equality's open-source, offline-first learning platform for delivering educational content and supporting learning in low-connectivity settings.
title: Kolibri

description: Korbit is a machine-learning, NLP, and reinforcement-learning platform developed to provide interactive, personalized tutoring through lecture videos, exercises, automated free-text solution checking, and adaptive interventions.
title: Korbit dialogue-based intelligent tutoring system

description: A short-range copying assessment that measures preschool children's handwriting legibility by having them reproduce Korean alphabet letters in designated boxes; it was used by Seo S-M (2018).
title: Korean alphabet writing assessment for handwriting legibility

description: A curated corpus of 398 text-only multiple-choice questions from the Korean Society of Anesthesiologists in-training examinations, assembled by the study authors from KSA examination materials for evaluating AI performance.
title: Korean Society of Anesthesiologists in-training examination question set (398 text-only questions, 2018–2022)

description: KoROM is a web-based platform developed for rehabilitation outcome-measure training and administration, providing digital score entry and instructional videos for therapists and physical therapy learners.
title: KoROM web-based learning platform for rehabilitation outcome measure training
